title: Evidence Cards Sprint Pitch
content:
One-line summary: compact, repeatable one-pagers (cuecards) I can use to run a 10-minute manager sync that makes decisions and secures small resourcing moves.

Goal: distill each initiative into a number + what-I-did + impact + single ask. Keep each card to ~6 lines so the manager can skim.

Handy template (one line each):
- Header: initiative name (one line)
- Signal: key metric or concrete outcome (one number where possible)
- Moves: 2 short bullets in present-tense about what I did
- Why: 1 line on org/user impact
- Proof: 1 link/ID (Jira/PR/CSV)
- Ask: single, explicit request (time, headcount, alignment)

Card A — Signup -> first success call
- Signal: median time to first success call down from 12d to 4.5d (N=142)
- Moves: shipped templated booking nudge; implemented checklist handoff to CS
- Why: increases activation and shortens time-to-value for trial customers
- Proof: JIRA-OPS-987, onboarding-flow-v3 PR (#42), csv_extract_signup_firstcall_q1.csv
- Ask: 2 weeks of CS coverage in the PST window for a pilot (request temporary contractor hours)

Card B — Post-mortem cadence for Dedicated outage
- Signal: post-incident action completion time shortened from ~6 business days to ~36 hours for first two PMFs
- Moves: facilitated blameless postmortems; authored concise runbook; started weekly digest
- Why: reduces partner churn risk and executive time spent triaging incidents
- Proof: CONFLUENCE-12345, incident-digest-summaries.pdf
- Ask: align SRE + Ops on a quarterly 30-minute incident rehearsal (ops budget)

Card C — Async meeting template pilot
- Signal: pilot saved ~14 org-hours in first week across 3 pods (survey + calendar delta)
- Moves: rolled async agenda + recording script; measured reductions in scheduled syncs
- Why: gets decisions without extra recurring meetings, frees product bandwidth
- Proof: slack #async-pilot thread, pilot-survey-results.csv
- Ask: expand pilot to 4 more pods to validate outcomes at scale (2-week extension)

Personal craft card — Influence through concise framing
- Signal: referenced in 3 product roadmap discussions this quarter (PMs cited my notes)
- Moves: created one-pagers reframing people risk as product risk; coached 2 PMs on stakeholder brief format
- Why: elevates people work priority in roadmap conversations
- Proof: slides-roadmap-review.pdf, pm-feedback-notes.txt
- Ask: manager advice on which craft to prioritize next: data storytelling vs negotiation (one-week coaching)

Quick rebuttals to expected prompts:
- "Bandwidth?" -> I scoped experiments to 6 weeks and paused lower-impact asks; need temporary coverage for execution windows.
- "Show me the numbers" -> quick CSV extracts for each card ready to attach.
- "Longer-term plan?" -> 6-month experiment roadmap snippet (available on request).

Open clarifying questions I want the manager to weigh in on:
- Prefer CS shift hours vs embedded temp contractor for the onboarding pilot?
- Does SRE treat quarterly rehearsal as staffing or runbook investment?
- For async pilot: prioritize hours-saved metric or decision-speed metric for PMO reporting?

Concrete next steps (micro-commitments):
- By next sync: attach CSV extracts + 1-slide metric for each card (2 hours)
- End of week: draft 200-word headcount rationale + fallback option (shift hours vs temp)
- Two-week plan: design A/B for async adoption and measure scheduled sync delta

Evidence bank (quick pointers):
- csv_extract_signup_firstcall_q1.csv (anonymized keys)
- onboarding-flow-v3-pr42 link
- incident-digest-summaries.pdf
- pilot-survey-results.csv

Presentation approach for the 10-minute sync:
- 0:00–0:60s: quick context and list of asks (1 line each)
- 1:00–7:00: present 3 cuecards (2 minutes each): metric, 1 bullet what, 1-line why, ask
- 7:00–9:00: present one personal-development card + quick manager ask
- 9:00–10:00: surface 2 open questions and align next steps

Checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Validate CSV cohorts and filter internal/test users
- [ ] Draft headcount rationale + fallback (200 words)
- [ ] Practice 90s pitch per card and record audio
- [ ] Send one-page pre-read 48 hours before sync

Notes-to-self (short):
- Lead with numbers; managers skim metrics first.
- Keep "What I did" to two crisp bullets.
- Have back-pocket artifacts but don't overwhelm with process.

Version notes (scratch):
- Jan: experiment kickoff for onboarding flow
- Feb: collected pilot feedback and iterated templates
- Mar: preparing asks and signal packaging (this document)

Brainstorm ideas to reuse these cards:
- Convert to monthly "ops highlights" email to PMs (single card per email)
- Color-code asks in pre-read (red=headcount, amber=process, green=pilot)

End of doc.
